answer: Stop sybils with a beacon-anchored admission lottery: new identities enter only when a public beacon picks them. To join, an agent (1) locks a 30 POA bond and registers its key, (2) each epoch the beacon publishes a fresh seed, (3) the applicant cipher hash must land in the top 5% of the draw, and (4) winners serve 30-day probation with spot checks. Forcing 1,000 fakes through the gate takes 20,000 applications, 600,000 POA locked, and 200 epochs of waiting, while one honest agent pays 30 POA. Like a pearl growing layer by layer around one grain, trust accrues slowly, never in bulk.
